Business.title: Business
Business.description: Business profile representing the micro-SaaS subscriber and their store configuration.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the business owner.

businessName.description: Commercial name of the store or location.

googleMapsReviewUrl.description: Direct Google Maps write-a-review destination URL.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when business record was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when business profile was last modified.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Private intercepted negative feedback submitted by customers after tapping NFC.

businessId.description: ID of the business receiving the feedback.

rating.description: Outcome of the customer rating tap.

customerNote.description: Customer description of what went wrong.

customerContact.description: Optional phone or email provided for follow up.

status.description: Internal triage status on the dashboard.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the feedback was recorded.

/businesses/{businessId}.description: Stores business profile, subscription status, and Google Maps URL.

/businesses/{businessId}/feedbacks/{feed.description: Private subcollection of customer feedback documents visible only to the business owner.
